title: Patagonia and the Cost of Values
short_teaser: Patagonia has repeatedly tied its brand to environmental commitments, repairs, product longevity, and activism.
story: Patagonia has repeatedly tied its brand to environmental commitments, repairs, product longevity, and activism. Values became credible because they influenced operations and tradeoffs, not only advertising. A value becomes a strategy when it changes what the business is willing to do or refuse. Strong businesses create value people can understand and trust. The lesson is usually found in the decisions beneath the success story. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
